```sql
select a.issuing_bank as key,
       count(*) as value
from payment_attempts a
where not a.is_test
  and a.method = 'card'
  and a.status = 'failed'
  and a.business_date between date '2026-09-01' and date '2026-09-09'
  and a.issuing_bank is not null
group by a.issuing_bank
order by value desc, key asc
```
